notes: All dimensions in decimal inches; weights in pounds, based on carbon steel (A105). Fractional catalog values converted to decimals.
Class 2000 (threaded) rows were excluded per project scope (classes 3000/6000/9000 only).
Plugs and bushings are published by the catalog as a single combined class '3000/6000' table; the class field for those rows is '3000/6000'.

Legend keys are suffixed by fitting family because the same letter has different meanings on different catalog pages; dims in each row use the plain letter (A, AA, B, C, D, D_min, E, E_min, F, G, H, J_min).
Reducing coupling dimensions and weights are those of the corresponding full coupling size (catalog note); reducers smaller than 1/4 in are not offered.
The SP-83 union table covers both threaded and socket-weld variants in one table (E_min and F are socket-end data); rows are recorded once under connection 'TH'.
Values transcribed exactly as printed, including apparent catalog misprints: tee TH 3000 NPS 2 B = 1 11/32 (expected 3 11/32) and bossWithLip SW 6000 NPS 1 F = 1.340 (expected 1.330).
Excluded catalog sections: socket-weld reducer inserts (MSS SP-79, compound sizes), Rockwood unions (proprietary, no B16.11 class), and lug nut unions (proprietary Stub Acme threads).
